title: Planting
previewText: The provisions of Section 23-613 (Front yard planting requirements) shall apply, except that plantings shall additionally not be required in the area of the zoning lot between the street line and any portion of ground floor level street walls allocated to non-residential uses with no sleeping accommodations.
